cohort.scope: The same participants contributed perception training, perception testing and imagery. Raw data, preprocessing branches and feature formats are representations of this cohort, not additional cohorts.

primary_source_join.basis: The paper explicitly directs readers to the author repository; its Dataset section explicitly links the Figshare processed deposit and OpenNeuro raw accession. The Figshare publisher description independently identifies the paper and raw accession. This is an explicit data-deposit join, not an inference from a generic code URL.

processed_data.release_selection_status: Observed publisher version 8 is not a newly selected benchmark release. The selected processing branch and full original-file checksum join remain unqualified.
processed_data.original_paper_branch: SPM5, native individual T1w, combined Subject[1-5].h5; corrected category_index and image_index on 2020-07-27 per publisher history.
processed_data.alternative_branch: fMRIPrep 1.2.1 native individual T1w: Subject[1-5]_ImageNetTraining.h5, _ImageNetTest.h5, _Imagery.h5; updated 2020-10-16 per publisher history. Not an interchangeable preprocessing choice.
processed_data.checksums: File MD5s and sizes are publisher declarations from saved version-8 metadata; no payload body was read or locally verified.
processed_data.image_features: ImageFeatures.h5 and ImageFeatures.mat are publisher-declared equivalent-content visual features; they are derived features, not the original stimulus images.

raw_data.qualification_limit: Snapshot 1.2.1 is explicit in Figshare metadata for anatomy. The raw file inventory and any benchmark-selected raw snapshot were not independently fetched or qualified.

access_and_rights.stimulus_images: The author repository requires a request for original stimulus images because of copyright. No stimulus-image or third-party rights are inferred from the code MIT license or the Figshare CC BY 4.0 record.
access_and_rights.processing_and_redistribution_qualificat: Preserve existing data, stimulus, model and third-party code access/redistribution holds.

remaining_holds: Freeze corrected SPM5 versus fMRIPrep branch using the intended task estimand and original retained source binding.
Join all benchmark-selected original-file pins to one frozen publisher release; the present publisher MD5s are declarations, not local payload verification.
Qualify actual axes, row IDs, ROI units, category joins, preprocessing and split/cue leakage under the existing protected ingestion protocol.
Keep stimulus/model/third-party code terms, provider/native runtime custody, full-panel execution and scientific qualification holds.
